title: Congress party to hold Samvidhan Raksha march in Lucknow

tea.why: The party alleges manipulation of electoral rolls and an assault on constitutional institutions and democratic rights.
tea.want: To protect the Constitution, safeguard democratic institutions, and defend the fundamental right to vote.
tea.changed: Nov 25: The Congress party announced nationwide marches for Constitution Day, with party President Mallikarjun Kharge to lead the Lucknow event.

summary: The Indian National Congress has scheduled nationwide 'Samvidhan Raksha' (Constitution Protection) marches for November 26, 2026, to mark Constitution Day. In Lucknow, the event will be led by Congress President Mallikarjun Kharge. According to AICC general secretary KC Venugopal, the marches aim to protest alleged irregularities in electoral rolls, which the party describes as 'Vote Chori' (vote theft). The party claims that the Election Commission of India's Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls has led to the mass deletion of genuine voters, disproportionately affecting marginalized communities. Participants are expected to pay tribute at statues of BR Ambedkar or Mahatma Gandhi, read the Preamble, and take an oath to protect the Constitution. The party also plans to launch a 'Vote Rakshak' campaign to assist voters in verifying their registration status.
response: No official response reported in the sources.
